label: q2-audit-operator
query:
select jsonb_build_object(
  'matchedReferenceCount', (select count(*) from public.operator_audit_events where (target_id::text~'937131f9-5417-4ab4-aebd-a5714681f6dd|9e2d04e2-cafb-4ff6-988b-348f0279bba3|d80d80dc-4833-4ab2-9e30-48efaef68d1d'or metadata::text~'937131f9-5417-4ab4-aebd-a5714681f6dd|9e2d04e2-cafb-4ff6-988b-348f0279bba3|d80d80dc-4833-4ab2-9e30-48efaef68d1d')),
  'references', (
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'auditId', id, 'at', created_at, 'matchedEntityId', matched_entity,
      'payloadKeys', payload_keys
    ) order by created_at, id), '[]'::jsonb)
    from (
      select id, created_at, target_id as matched_entity,
        (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(key order by key), '[]'::jsonb)
         from jsonb_object_keys(case when jsonb_typeof(metadata) = 'object'
           then metadata else '{}'::jsonb end) as key) as payload_keys
      from public.operator_audit_events
      where (target_id::text~'937131f9-5417-4ab4-aebd-a5714681f6dd|9e2d04e2-cafb-4ff6-988b-348f0279bba3|d80d80dc-4833-4ab2-9e30-48efaef68d1d'or metadata::text~'937131f9-5417-4ab4-aebd-a5714681f6dd|9e2d04e2-cafb-4ff6-988b-348f0279bba3|d80d80dc-4833-4ab2-9e30-48efaef68d1d')
      order by created_at, id
      limit 100
    ) as limited
  )
 )
